_comment: PA Secretary Mode · CORPORATE tier (SPEC v2.1 §14 — #116 Board-meeting pack + #117 Departmental update + #118 VIP & stakeholder), built to the §21 ADVANCED standard. NEW l10n keys {key: [bn, en]} to merge into app_bn.arb / app_en.arb. Emitted by the PA-CORP build (screens: app/lib/screens/pa/board_pack_screen.dart, dept_update_screen.dart, vip_stakeholder_screen.dart; engines: backend/core/logic/pa_board.py, pa_dept.py, pa_vip.py). ZERO Bangla glyphs live in any .dart — every Bangla string is here and is real & natural. ৳ is exempt (kept as-is where it appears in user data). The deterministic structure/counting is a MOCK — the UI always shows the honest paAiReviewMarker ('AI-generated — review') where a draft/roll-up is produced; the AI-draft seams (paBoardAiSeam*, paDeptAiSeam*) are documented key-gated states that NEVER fabricate prose. VIP is fully deterministic + conservative privacy (no AI path). Parameterized keys are under _params — add each to the merge script's PARAMS map so gen-l10n emits the String Function(...) signatures. REUSED existing keys (NOT redefined here): cancel, copy, copied, delete, deleteFailed, loadFailed, retry, save, saveFailed, share, paAiReviewMarker. Key names were checked for NO collision with existing PA keys.
